howto: A block slides left and right above the tower.
Tap, click or press Space to drop it.
Only the part that lands on the stack stays; the overhang falls away, so the next block is narrower.
Land 20 blocks to finish the tower. Miss the stack completely and the run ends.
tips: Drop when the block's edges meet the stack's edges, not when its middle crosses.
A near-perfect drop keeps the full width and adds to your star streak, but each one speeds the slide up a little.
Each new block starts 60 px to one side: wait for it to swing back before you drop.
Easy caps the slide speed, so it is the place to practise PERFECT streaks.

controls.keyboard: Space to start and drop a block. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere on the tower to drop. Pause button top left.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard buttons on the title screen set the starting slide speed (slow, medium, fast). Every PERFECT drop speeds it up; on Easy the speed never passes a gentle cap.

cheats.effect: Every new block comes back at full width
Dashed lines mark the stack edges so you can line up each drop
The tower cycles through rainbow colours

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere or press Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the MISSED! or TOWER COMPLETE! card to play again
features.best-score-badge: BEST in the top-left corner during play, and on the results card
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card inside the title screen with an animated tap; replay from Pause > How to play > Replay tutorial
features.results: MISSED! / TOWER COMPLETE! card with blocks stacked and best
